about: Lyric-prompt A/B trial, started 2026-11-07. Ten rewrites (1-10) of the standing lyric prompt (0 = base, for reference only, not dealt). Each new song is dealt one variant by tools/prompt_deal.mjs: a shuffled cycle, so every variant is used once per 10 songs in random order. Record the filled prompt, the lyrics and BlazeDale’s verdict per song; compare verdicts by variant over time.
